steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each group is placed by its size and by whether it is reported only in aggregate.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 individual result appears in a group report

findings.title: Individual result shown in a group report
Group below the minimum of five tested
findings.fix: Merge it with a related group

findings.title: Reference value with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the value

outcome.notChecked: Individual health; clinical interpretation, which the occupational health provider gives.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] group-welding.csv:12  Individual result shown in a group report.
       Fix: Remove the individual result.
[medium] group-paint.csv:19  Group below the minimum of five tested.
       Fix: Merge it with a related group.
[low] reference-values.md:26  Reference value with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the value.
Not checked: Individual health; clinical interpretation, which the occupational health provider gives.
pros: Checks a group with fewer than the minimum number tested (default 5), a group reported with an individual's result, and a reference value with no source.
cons: Not checked: Individual health; clinical interpretation, which the occupational health provider gives.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-health-surveillance skill on the records for this review.
